target: Produce a deterministic, evidence-backed 40-source ChatGPT Project upload set replacing the current set with current-main truth, plus a complete open-PR impact ledger and freshness policy.
invariants: Repository inspection, source-governance, deterministic assembly, and packaging only.
Do not modify canonical authority documents to improve the upload.
Do not merge, close, or mutate any pull request.
Do not upload or mutate the ChatGPT Project.
Every current-main-derived upload file is copied byte-for-byte from EXECUTION_BASE_SHA.
Unmerged PR content is never promoted into the authoritative 40; open PRs are represented only via the generated impact ledger.
Fail closed on missing source identity, hash mismatch, duplicate filenames, invalid JSON/YAML, or incomplete open-PR classification.
No 'final forever' claim while material source-affecting PRs remain open.

execution.agent is set to the schema-valid fallback 'shell': the canonical Task Packet schema's execution.agent enum (gemini|codex|vibe|shell) has no 'claude' value, though this packet's own directive names Claude Code/Sonnet as primary implementer. The actual executing tool for this run was Claude Code CLI (Sonnet). Adding a 'claude' enum value is a schema change and is explicitly out of scope for this packet (see section 4.2); flagged as a residual gap for a follow-up packet.

pr.title: docs(fdos-004): refresh ChatGPT Project 40-source upload set to current main
pr.body:
## Summary
- Deterministic 40-file ChatGPT Project upload set rebuilt from current main (EXECUTION_BASE_SHA 5f862d36f5417801b9fe148fccbb439731627234), replacing the stale FDOS-003 set.
- Full open-PR impact ledger for all 21 currently-open PRs, each classified exactly once; 3 material (draft/behind PRs touching selected slots).
- Source-freshness policy and machine-readable source manifest with per-file blob SHA + SHA-256.
- Deterministic assembler + validator under scripts/project_sources/, reproducible byte-for-byte across reruns (verified) and byte-identical ZIP across reruns (verified).

## Scope
Docs/package assembly only. No runtime/source/config/test/dependency/CI changes.

## Validation
All gates PASS: source count (40), filename, source identity (byte-for-byte vs EXECUTION_BASE_SHA), hash, duplicate-content, JSON, YAML, open-PR conservation (21/21), secret scan. ZIP integrity + sidecar verified. Reproducibility verified for both UPLOAD_FILES and the ZIP itself.

## Package Disposition
CURRENT_MAIN_VALID_PENDING_OPEN_PR_REFRESH -- valid for current main today; 3 open PRs (#1150, #1136, #1126) would require regenerating specific slots if merged. See 40_OPEN_PR_IMPACT_LEDGER.md.

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- doc-trust-map.md (slot 08) is dated 2026-04-30 with next_review 2026-07-29, one day past packaging date.
- PR #1123 (RTE audit improvement) is classified SUPERSEDED_OR_CONFLICTING based on its scale (16,206 changed files) and prior-session findings; not independently re-litigated here.

## Operator Notes
- Upload files from UPLOAD_FILES/ (40 files) to replace the ChatGPT Project's current source set.
- No ChatGPT Project upload or mutation was performed by this packet.

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, worktree, EXECUTION_BASE_SHA resolution, and live open-PR inventory capture (21 PRs).

EXECUTION_BASE_SHA recorded and matches origin/main at capture time.

steps.task: Resolve all 37 copied-source slots against current-main candidate paths, adjudicating every conflict with explicit evidence (blob existence, doc-trust-map trust rating, packet wording).
validation: Every one of the 37 slots has a single selected source_path backed by a git cat-file -e check at EXECUTION_BASE_SHA.
Every rejected candidate has an explicit reason and evidence string.

steps.task: Capture full detail for all 21 open PRs and classify each exactly once against the watched-path families and selected slots.
validation: Open PR inventory count equals ledger entry count (21 = 21).
Every classification is one of the five allowed values with named evidence.

validation: Rebuilding from unchanged inputs produces byte-identical UPLOAD_FILES.

steps.task: Run all validation gates, rerun the PR-drift recheck immediately before finalization, refresh evidence for any changed-head PR, and rebuild if drift is found.
validation: PR drift recheck performed; #1150's changed head SHA was refreshed and the package rebuilt before finalization.

steps.task: Build the ZIP and SHA-256 sidecar deterministically; verify integrity and reproducibility.
validation: Rebuilding the ZIP from unchanged inputs produces a byte-identical archive (verified, no timestamp-limitation caveat needed).

validation: Embedded audit verdict is PASS or non-blocking PASS_WITH_RISKS.
